what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating cardiologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
It must specifically include clinical correlation with echocardiogram findings.
Echocardiogram (Echo). Report from a 2- D and Doppler flow study performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.

rows.label: A
rows.condition: Systolic Grade 1/6 or 2/6 OR flow, functional, innocent, or physiological

rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating cardiologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

2. It must specifically include clinical correlation with echocardiogram findings.

3. Echocardiogram (Echo). Report from a 2- D and Doppler flow study performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.
